title: [ARKNIGHTS X RAINBOW SIX SIEGE] SIDESTORY: OPERATION LUCENT ARROWHEAD OPEN
lines: 01 [ARKNIGHTS X RAINBOW SIX SIEGE] SIDESTORY: OPERATION LUCENT ARROWHEAD OPEN

DETAILS: Operation Lucent Arrowhead event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
EVENT STAGES DURATION: Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
Phase 1
DURATION: September 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7) Open Stages: Roam the Exhibition
Phase 2
DURATION: September 12, 2024, 16:00 (UTC-7) - September 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7) Open Stages: Skydiving
[Spec Ops Notes]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Spec Ops Notes] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Fuze], Galería Krysztauowa Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Galería Stamp Card, etc.
[Galería Boutique]
DURATION: September 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 26, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Galería Stamp Card by clearing event stages and completing [Spec Ops Notes] missions. Galería Stamp Card can be used to redeem items from [Galería Boutique].
REWARD: Fuze's token, Galería Krysztauowa Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
- During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
02 [ARKNIGHTS X RAINBOW SIX SIEGE] LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – STORM, REINFORCE, MISSIONS CYCLE
DURATION: September 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Storm, Reinforce, Missions Cycle], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting
★★★★★: Doc / Iana
Note:
-[Storm, Reinforce, Missions Cycle] is a [Special Ops Headhunting].
-New Operators Ela, Doc, Iana are ONLY available from the [Special Ops Headhunting], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
-Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 [ARKNIGHTS X RAINBOW SIX SIEGE] STORM, REINFORCE, MISSIONS CYCLE LIMITED LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: September 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Log in during the event to claim reward on event page: Elite Forces Headhunting Permit * 1
NOTE:
-Elite Forces Headhunting Permit can only be used to performing a 10-roll in [Storm, Reinforce, Missions Cycle] Limited Headhunting.
-Each account can only claim this reward once during the event.
-Elite Forces Headhunting Permit expires at: September 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7).
04 [ARKNIGHTS X RAINBOW SIX SIEGE] LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: September 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - September 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 10 days to receive generous rewards, including: Elite Forces Headhunting Permit, Icon 'All In A Glance', Orundum, and more.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2: Chip Catalyst * 1, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Orundum * 200, Data Supplement Stick * 10
Day 4: Tactical Battle Record * 20, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 5: Orundum * 200, Furniture Part * 300
Day 6: Skill Summary - 2 * 20, Strategic Battle Record * 10
Day 7: Orundum * 200, LMD * 30000
Day 8: Expert Headhunting Permit * 1, Data Supplement Instrument * 3
Day 9: Module Data Block * 1, Skill Summary - 3 * 8
Day 10: Icon 'All In A Glance' * 1, Pure Gold * 20
NOTE: Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
05 [ARKNIGHTS X RAINBOW SIX SIEGE] NEW OPERATOR NOW AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game.
★★★★★：Iana
★★★★★：Fuze
Note:
-Operator Fuze is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Operation Lucent Arrowhead, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
-New Operators Ela, Doc, Iana are ONLY available from the [Special Ops Headhunting], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
-Ela, Doc, Iana, and Fuze will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.
06 [ARKNIGHTS X RAINBOW SIX SIEGE] COLLAB OUTFITS NOW AVAILABLE
DURATION: September 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - October 3, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- CROSSOVER Collection - Safehouse for Ela
- CROSSOVER Collection - Exhibition for Doc
- CROSSOVER Collection - Mirrormaze for Iana
NOTE: [Outfit Voucher] cannot be used to redeem the collab outfits.
